editorial_reason: Direct Stacks Definition 9.2.1 and Stacks Section 10.2 ring convention. Exclude zero ring; invertibility requires two-sided product equal to 1.
Direct Stacks Definition 4.2.8. Contravariant functors reverse arrows and are separately sourced elsewhere; do not confuse functors and pseudofunctors.
Direct Stacks Definition 4.2.5, following Definitions 4.2.1 and 4.2.4. Not the same as a single-object groupoid or an abelian group.

Direct Stacks Definition 4.29.5. Pseudofunctor is NOT the same as a strict functor; record invertible unit, composition and coherence data. Base A is an ordinary category, target C is a strict 2-category under Stacks conventions.
